The [[Chest of the Slaver]] is a [[Dungeon Chest]] that will spawn after defeating the [[Forgewight]], [[Justiciar Thommis]], [[Rand Stormweaver]] or [[Selvetarm]] in the [[Slavers' Exile]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode).

''Drop research is ongoing, and may be found [[Chest of the Slaver/Research|here]].''
